root_causes: Relevant general and bridging passages were absent from abstract-only retrieval.
The general-reference exchars parameter was capped at 1200; the causal explanation was cut off.
A bridge source was omitted from connection generation if neither endpoint cited it.
Repeated model IDs across insight sections removed distinct nodes and the requested endpoint.
Connection contracts allowed empty premises and malformed source-anchor labels.
Strict nested generation contracts produced malformed output, whitespace loops and lost connection endpoints in live provider runs.
An unordered endpoint list and overlapping role flags made review judgments harder to interpret.
One large node-check request could exhaust the shared review deadline.
A full optional refinement could replace previously checked connections with a worse map; targeted connection refinement now retains unchanged checked records.
A small node-check batch could make incorrect whole-map absence claims; those batch-local notes are now discarded while individual verdict reasons remain.
Scientific support did not independently establish discovery attribution or dates; each now requires a separate affirmative assessment.
Straight edges in the stable personal-map layout could pass through an unrelated node; obstructed edges now bend around it.
